$comment: Unit traits (G-62, Kev 2026-10-09): one always-on rule per unit. `traits` defines each trait: its name, its one-line text and its numbers. A trait's name is a title read with the unit's callsign (BARBED STALKER, G-63); its key here is the internal id the engine tests and never shows. `warning: true` draws the card marker in the warning colour. `needs` (G-64) lists what the trait needs from its unit's kit, as keys of `requirements`; [] for a trait that needs nothing. `requirements` defines each one over the ability fields of heroes.data.json and enemies.data.json: a kit meets it when ONE ability has every `all` field set, at least one `any` field set (when given) and no `none` field set (set = true or above 0). validate-data refuses a unit whose kit does not meet its trait's needs. Nothing in the game reads `needs` yet: it is groundwork for trait pools. A {key} in the text is filled from the trait's own numbers; {band} is the unit's first roll window. `evolutions` (heroId/evolutionId) lists the TWO traits a branch chooses between at 250 XP (G-71): the branch's signature trait first, then the one that was a Directive. A hero has no trait until it picks one. `enemies` (display name) says which enemy has which. `legacyDirectives` maps the name of each Directive that became a trait to that trait: a run saved before G-71 stores the Directive's name, and loading it reads the trait here. Who may have one: every hero evolution that has reached 250 XP (one of its two), every elite, and in Mantle Hunt every unit but the boss (Feral, G-66; Basalt Ape and Magma Drake keep their Accrete keyword as well). Base heroes, evolved heroes below 250 XP, every other regular unit, the tanks and supports of the other four operations, and all five bosses have none. The `traits` gate checks that rule, that every trait is used, and that every number printed is the number the engine applies.

exposed.name: Ruthless
exposed.text: Its area attacks deal +{amount} to marked enemies.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.text: After rolling {band}, its next leech heals {pct}% more.

retaliate.name: Vengeful
retaliate.text: When hit while taunting, its spike deals +{amount}.

glacialArmor.name: Glacial
glacialArmor.text: At round start, gains {amount} shield per frozen enemy.

dugIn.name: Entrenched
dugIn.text: At round start, gains {amount} shield while below half HP.

triage.name: Watchful
triage.text: Its heals restore +{amount} on the lowest-HP ally.

overflow.name: Overflowing
overflow.text: Its healing past full HP becomes shield.

redline.name: Redline
redline.text: +{amount} damage on every attack while you have {protocol} or more Protocol.

ghostSignal.name: Spectral
ghostSignal.text: Jams it applies from cloak last {rounds} extra round.

silentKill.name: Silent
silentKill.text: An ambush that kills its target keeps the cloak.

cleanKill.name: Relentless
cleanKill.text: When it kills, the lowest-HP enemy becomes marked.

static.name: Static
static.text: At round start, the highest enemy die drops by {amount}.

zeroDay.name: Zero-Day
zeroDay.text: Enemies it rewrites take +{amount} damage until the rewrite ends.

flashpoint.name: Searing
flashpoint.text: Its burns deal one tick of damage as they land.

conductor.name: Forking
conductor.text: Its chains jump to {jumps} more enemy.

serrated.name: Serrated
serrated.text: Its pierce attacks also breach the target.

thermalTrauma.name: Scalding
thermalTrauma.text: Its attacks deal +{amount} to burning enemies.

shatterpoint.name: Shattering
shatterpoint.text: Its attacks deal +{amount} to enemies with a frozen die.

fieldSurgeon.name: Reviving
fieldSurgeon.text: Its revive brings a hero back at {pct}% HP.

reinforcedMesh.name: Reinforcing
reinforcedMesh.text: While it lives, shields the squad gains are +{amount}.

deepCells.name: Capacitive
deepCells.text: While it lives, the Protocol cap is +{amount}.

silentRunning.name: Shrouded
silentRunning.text: Cloaks after using an ability that deals no damage.

vanish.name: Vanishing
vanish.text: Once per battle, cloaks when damage leaves it below {pct}% HP.

feedback.name: Shrieking
feedback.text: Enemies under its roll penalties take {amount} damage each round.

signalTheft.name: Siphoning
signalTheft.text: Gain {amount} Protocol for each enemy its roll penalties hit.

backup.name: Vigilant
backup.text: When an ally is hit, gains {amount} shield.

discharge.name: Volatile
discharge.text: When it dies, deals {amount} damage to each hero.

barbed.name: Barbed
barbed.text: Heroes that hit it take {amount} damage.

litany.name: Zealous
litany.text: At round start, the lowest enemy die rises by {amount}.

decoy.name: Illusory
decoy.text: The first hit against it each battle is negated.

compel.name: Commanding
compel.text: Its roll penalties last {rounds} extra round.

packRage.name: Feral
packRage.text: When an ally dies, gains rampage.
